ABOUT THIS PAGE

dorawolf .com

DoraWolf是我的个人网站，用来分享我做过的项目，一些技术作品和一些兴趣爱好的展示。

我热衷于分享我所做过的项目，并展示我在技术领域的实践和探索。通过这个网站，我希望能够与大家分享我的创作、技术和生活爱好。同时也欢迎互动和交流。无论是在建筑、设计、自然还是其他领域，我都会不断更新和分享我的作品。

DoraWolf is my personal website, used to share projects I have worked on, some technical works, and displays of interests and hobbies.

I am passionate about sharing projects I have worked on and showcasing my practice and exploration in the field of technology. Through this website, I hope to share my creativity, skills, and hobbies with everyone. Interaction and communication are also welcome. Whether in architecture, design, nature, or other fields, I will constantly update and share my works.
